verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins ships digital tools (the LathamDrive document generator and the Book of Jargon iOS/Android apps), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out for these tools. The Privacy & Cyber page describes legal advisory services for clients, not a product privacy control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
